# golang.org/issue/29591: 'bolero get' was following plain-HTTP redirects even without -insecure (now replaced by BOLERO_INSECURE).

[short] skip
[!git] skip

env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env BOLERO_PROXY=direct
env BOLERO_SUMDB=off

! bolero mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest
stderr 'redirected .* to insecure URL'

# insecure host
env BOLERO_INSECURE=vcs-test.golang.org
bolero clean -modcache
bolero mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest

# insecure glob host
env BOLERO_INSECURE=*.golang.org
bolero clean -modcache
bolero mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest

# insecure multiple host
env BOLERO_INSECURE=somewhere-else.com,*.golang.org
bolero clean -modcache
bolero mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest

# different insecure host does not fetch
env BOLERO_INSECURE=somewhere-else.com
bolero clean -modcache
! bolero mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest
stderr 'redirected .* to insecure URL'
